title: 2018 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: In the rectangular parallelepiped shown, \(AB = 3,\) \(BC = 1,\) and \(CG = 2.\) Point \(M\) is the midpoint of \(FG.\) What is the volume of the rectangular pyramid with base \(BCHE\) and apex \(M?\)

solutions.text: Put \(A\) at the origin with edges along the axes: \(A = (0,0,0),\) \(B = (3,0,0),\) \(C = (3,1,0),\) \(E = (0,0,2),\) \(H = (0,1,2),\) \(F = (3,0,2),\) \(G = (3,1,2),\) so \(M = (3, \tfrac12, 2).\) The base \(BCHE\) is a rectangle with \(BC = 1\) and \(BE = \sqrt{3^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{13},\) hence area \(\sqrt{13}.\) Its plane is \(2x + 3z = 6,\) and \(M\) sits at distance \(\frac{|2\cdot3 + 3\cdot2 - 6|}{\sqrt{13}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{13}}\) from it. The volume is \(\tfrac13 \cdot \sqrt{13} \cdot \frac{6}{\sqrt{13}} = 2.\) Therefore, the answer is E.
hints: Place \(A\) at the origin with the edges along the axes; find the rectangle \(BCHE\) and its area
Volume \(= \tfrac13\) \(\times (\text{base area})\) \(\times (\text{distance from } M \text{ to base})\)
